# Offer Hunter
> An AI browser extension that matches resumes to job descriptions and generates tailored outreach when the fit is high.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/offer-hunter/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/offer-hunter

Status: documented
Last verified: 2026-11-17
